title: Manual corrections, pins, and automatic refinement
plainLanguage: Automatic tracking can suggest. A hand correction must win until the user explicitly reopens it.
purpose: Preserve human work and make iterative refinement safe.

rules.statement: Automatic passes must not overwrite protected manual pins or accepted snapshots.
Refinement results remain proposals until applied; applying them is not the same as verification.
Use two checked nearby pins to guide interpolation when appropriate, but explicit hidden intervals block invented in-between positions.
Reopening a scope is deliberate and must not silently delete the history of prior review.

implementation.currentSupport: Implemented and tested in Corpus Pane.
implementation.futureWork: Use the same protection rules when external references influence suggestions.
